About

The guy who runs all of this.

When you reach out to Suncrest Studios, you're talking to me, not an AI chatbot. I have been doing this for over 15 years and my goal is to make you look and sound your very best. Sometimes that means a full production. Sometimes it means a small shoot, or as simple as taking something you already have and turning it into something useful.

If the project needs a bigger crew, I bring in people I trust. But you're not hiring a faceless agency. You're working with me.

— Jordan Gibby, Suncrest Studios
